app.name: CX Client Data Sidebar
app.short_description: Read-only client eligibility, claims, and EOB context for CX agents.
app.long_description: Shows read-only client context (eligibility, claims, EOB history) in the ticket sidebar, served by Alma's HIPAA-covered broker. The client is derived server-side from the ticket; the agent never composes or runs a query.
app.installation_instructions: Restrict this app to the CX agent group at install. Context loads automatically when an agent opens a ticket.
